text.card: A star about 65 parsecs away, 3.0 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 3.0 solar radii and 2.73 solar masses (FLAME) and 10,048 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: Iota Piscis Austrini
quotes.card: Iota Piscis Austrini, also named Baijiu, is a solitary, blue-white hued star in the southern constellation of Piscis Austrinus.
quotes.introduction: It has an apparent visual magnitude of +4.35 and is around 500 light years from the Sun.
